correctness.rationale: Only a backbone vertex can be a nontrivial middle vertex of a selected collinear triple. Three backbone vertices are impossible; with two v_i,v_j, allowed leaves are precisely those attached strictly between them. With one v_i, the allowed nonempty leaf sets lie all strictly on one side, or are a single own leaf. Leaves alone form a simplex. For a backbone pair with a nonempty interior leaf set, match each anchor-free face to the face adjoining one fixed interior leaf, descending by lower-face size. Any other strict coface has an additional non-anchor leaf and was removed earlier; another backbone cannot occur. This includes removing the bare backbone pair when it has interior leaves. For a single backbone vertex, match analogously on each nonempty side, leaving its anchor edge and removing no own-leaf edges. There are no interfering two-backbone cofaces, because only bare edges of that class remain. Finally match the leaf simplex to its anchor star, using only lower faces of size at least two, with no surviving non-leaf coface of such a face. These elementary free-face pairs leave every vertex. The leaf star and the backbone path survive and are joined by own-leaf edges. Remaining backbone pairs lie in a unique closed segment between consecutive leaf-bearing positions; its contribution is binom(g_j+2,2). The sum is m-1+sum binom(g_j+1,2) for m>=2, and zero when m=1. The connected remaining graph has L+m vertices and (L-1)+L+(2m-2)+e0 edges, so its graph rank is L+m-2+e0. Contracting a spanning tree gives the wedge homotopy type (the claimed elementary collapses are to the graph). This gives L-1 for stars, and all pairs with no larger faces for paths, hence binom(|V|-1,2); for P5 the rank is 6. Integral homology and free fundamental group then follow. The verifier, which tests freeness against current cofaces, and recorded output were inspected as bounded evidence; no uploaded code was run.
residual_risks: The reported 373 profiles, 60,300 initial faces and 23,078 collapse pairs are not an unbounded test or a fresh replay. The proof supplies the all-profile result.

checked_sources: Frozen RESULT.md, Finding and collapse proof
value.rationale: The theorem replaces a potentially high-dimensional complex by a concrete graph via elementary collapses, showing at once that higher integral homology vanishes and the fundamental group is free. It exposes how leaf multiplicity and gaps in the backbone affect that type, which face-polynomial or Euler data alone cannot do. The all-profile simplification gives a meaningful tractable tree family for comparison with higher-dimensional two-hub examples.
residual_risks: No result for arbitrary trees or equivariant collapse/homology is implied.
